page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Left of it is blank paper. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed. Inline superscript reference marks in the text. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: doctores propter Jesuiticam maledicendi & calumniandi libidinem. Omitto quod confitetur Maldonatus Jesuita com.[?] in Job. 2. 18. Calvinianos docere, nullis miraculis se à Deo missos esse. {11} Protestantium ministros nullam habere ordinationem legitimam, neque successionem ab apostolis: nullum ex episcopis illorum ab episcopo legitimo esse ordinatum: atque ita omnes carere auctoritate ordinis & jurisdictionis. Resp. Quamdiu conspicuus manet ordo & status legitimus ecclesiæ, ordinaria vocatio comprimis vigetur: ubi vero ille ipse ordo & status fuerit collapsus & interruptus, Deus præter morem solitum illum instaurat, per eos quos vult. Deinde antea ostensum est validissimis argumentis, Protestantium doctores & pastores legitimè juxta verbi divini præscriptum, & ecclesiæ primitivæ morem esse electos et vocatos ad ministerium Christi: atque ita auctoritate ordinis & jurisdictionis neutiquam carere. {13} Illos à qui-

page.notes: Superscript reference marks before "Protestantium" and "Illos" were read as 11 and 13 and are uncertain; the printed marks may be ligatures. "com." after "Jesuita" is doubtful. The "Maldonatus" citation is set in italic, and "Job" was read as printed. The catchword "à qui-" is taken as the first words of the next page. Stains and show-through were ignored. The right-hand strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
